seoTitle: How to Delete Your eBay Account and Close It in 2026
metaDescription: Learn how to permanently close your eBay account in 2026, handle pending payments and open cases first, and see exactly what data eBay deletes and retains.
intro: Whether you're stepping away from buying, selling, or moving to another platform, closing an eBay account permanently takes a few deliberate steps rather than a single button press. This guide walks through signing in, finding the closure option buried in My eBay's Account tab, and reading through eBay's own explanation of what closing your account actually does to your feedback, order history, and personal data before you commit. It's worth reading that fine print once, since the process isn't reversible after eBay finishes deleting your data.

steps.heading: Sign in to the account you're closing
steps.body: Start at eBay's sign-in screen and log in with the email or username tied to the account you want to close. You can sign in directly or through Google, Facebook, or Apple if that's how the account was originally set up — either way, you need to be logged in as that account, not a new one, since account closure isn't something support can do on your behalf without verifying you're the owner.

image.caption: eBay's sign-in screen, with email/username and social sign-in options — you need to log in as the account you're closing.

steps.heading: Open My eBay and go to Account
steps.body: Once signed in, go to My eBay and select the Account tab. This page is organized into Personal Info, Payment Information, and Account Preferences, and the option you want — Close account — sits at the very bottom of Account Preferences, below Team access, Advertisement Preferences, Communication Preferences, and AI Training Preferences. It's easy to scroll past, since eBay doesn't put it anywhere near the top of the page.

image.caption: The My eBay Account tab, with Close account listed last under Account Preferences, below the other settings links.

steps.heading: Read what closing your account actually means
steps.body: Clicking Close account takes you to eBay's help article on the subject before it lets you proceed, and it's worth actually reading it. eBay states plainly that once your account is closed, you'll no longer be able to sell on the site or access My eBay, and you'll lose your feedback along with your purchase and sales history. The page also suggests contacting support first if the closure is being driven by a fixable issue, since eBay would rather resolve the problem than lose you as a user.

image.caption: eBay's "Closing your account" help page, spelling out that you'll lose feedback and purchase/sales history once the account closes.

steps.heading: Clear anything that would block the request
steps.body: The same help page lists what has to be true before eBay will actually process a closure: all fees and selling costs need to be paid with your available funds at zero, you can't have open bids on an item, and any pending payments or unresolved buyer/seller cases need to be settled first. Leaving any of these open is the most common reason a closure request stalls, so work through the list before you submit anything.

steps.heading: Understand the data deletion timeline
steps.body: After you submit the request, eBay doesn't erase everything instantly — there's a processing window, and eBay's data deletion page explains that once your account is permanently closed and your data deleted, you can still contact support during that window to have it reopened, as long as the account was in good standing and not restricted or suspended. Closing your account also closes any linked eBay businesses that share the same identity, including the eBay Partner Network, so check for those before you confirm.

image.caption: eBay's data deletion explainer, covering the reopen window and noting that linked businesses like the eBay Partner Network close too.

steps.heading: Know what eBay keeps even after deletion
steps.body: eBay is explicit that some data survives the deletion process because they're legally required or permitted to retain it — records needed to comply with financial and legal obligations, detect and resolve fraud or security issues, and defend against legal claims all fall under this. Personal data that is deleted gets removed through approved methods like direct deletion, anonymization, and pseudonymization, and eBay sends a confirmation email to your registered address once the process completes.

steps.heading: Clear local data and plan for a fresh start
steps.body: Since your eBay account data is being deleted server-side, it's also worth clearing your cache, cookies, and browsing history from any browser you used to sign in, and deleting the eBay app from your phone if you're done with the platform entirely. If you ever want to come back, eBay is clear that you'll need to create an entirely new account rather than reactivate the closed one once it's past the reopen window.

faq.question: Can I undo an eBay account deletion?
faq.answer: During the processing window before data deletion completes, yes — contact eBay support to have it reopened if the account was in good standing. Once deletion is finished, it cannot be reversed.

faq.question: What happens to my order history when I delete my account?
faq.answer: You lose access to your feedback, purchase history, and sales history as soon as the account closes, so back up any receipts or seller communications beforehand.

faq.question: Can I close my eBay account if I have a pending sale?
faq.answer: No — eBay requires all fees and selling costs to be paid with your balance at zero, no open bids, and no unresolved cases before it will process a closure.

faq.question: Does eBay delete all my data immediately?
faq.answer: No, there's a processing window first, and even after deletion eBay retains some data it's legally required or permitted to keep, such as records related to fraud prevention or legal claims.

faq.question: Where exactly is the Close account option?
faq.answer: In My eBay, under the Account tab, at the bottom of the Account Preferences column — below Team access, Advertisement Preferences, Communication Preferences, and AI Training Preferences.
